title: feat(desktop): background copy toasts, Library badge and "copy ready" (NIW2-586)
body:
## What

Section 4 of the Prepare design ("In the background") for copies made in the background, on top of #448's Prepare screen.

- **Progress card** names the destination: its tile, "Preparing your YouTube copy…", a mono line "38% · about 2 min left · you can keep working", and a striped bar. **✕ now hides the card without cancelling.** A quiet **Cancel** under the bar still stops the export. If a hidden export fails, its error card (Retry / Close, unchanged) shows again.
- **Ready card** follows the design: the success fox, "Your YouTube copy is ready", "2560 × 1440 · 566 MB · in your Library" (those last words open the copy's page), **Show in Finder** (primary) and **Drag to upload** (the same native file drag as before). Light and Balanced copies still show where they fit on GitHub.
- **Editor exports** use the same cards under a generic name: "Preparing your export…" and "Your export is ready".
- **Library rail badge**: if a copy finishes while its ready card is not on screen (closed, or replaced by the next export), the LIBRARY rail item gets a pink count. `@kaipu/ui` `RailItem` gains optional `badge` / `badgeLabel` fields (screen readers hear "1 new copy ready"). Opening the Library clears the badge.
- **Library page**: a teal "✓ 1 copy ready" chip sits next to the title, and each copy not opened yet gets a pink outline (`VideoCard` gains a `justReady` prop plus CSS). Both clear per copy when it is opened: its page, Show in Finder, or a drag.

## Why

Making a 4K YouTube copy takes minutes. Before this PR, every card said "Making a lighter copy…" whatever the destination, the only way to put the card away was to cancel the export, and once "Ready to share" was closed nothing told the user the copy was waiting.

## Decisions

- **"Unseen" and "announced" are tracked separately** (`ready-copies.ts`, an in-memory store like the export runner).
  - A copy stays *unseen* until the user opens it or acts on it. The Library chip and outline follow this.
  - The rail badge counts only unseen copies the Library page has not shown yet ("announced").
  - Without the split, opening the Library would clear the chip it is meant to show.
- **The destination is derived in `usePrepareCopy`** from the preset (`destinationOfPreset`). Every Prepare entry point names it, and the Prepare page itself is untouched. `destination` is optional on `ExportJobInfo` and `StartExportArgs`.
- **The success fox** is the existing `KaipuLogo use="done"` mark, so no new asset.
- **Removed from the ready card**: "View file", the "N% lighter" line and the size meter. The design has two actions, and "in your Library" takes over from View file. The 11 `videoEditor` i18n keys this left unused are removed. New copy lives in one `backgroundCopy` namespace (en + neutral es).
- **The sidebar watches the route** (it is on every page): opening `/library` announces, and opening `/library/:assetId` marks that copy as seen. The library-detail page is not touched.
- **List view** gets no outline. The chip still counts those copies.
- The `export` E2E spec, the `mute-export` E2E spec and `verify/export.verify.ts` now look for the new card ("Your export is ready" → "in your Library"). **Not run here**: the owner does runtime QA.

Linear: [NIW2-586](https://linear.app/niway/issue/NIW2-586/background-copy-progress-and-ready-toasts-library-badge-copy-ready-in) · Design: [Kaipu Prepare.dc.html, section 4](https://claude.ai/design/p/71546ef1-baf5-42e9-8fcc-9b9b44f2c7ab?file=Kaipu+Prepare.dc.html) · Base: #448 · Doc: `apps/documentation/src/content/docs/backlog/background-copy-toasts.md`

## Verification

`bun run verify` passes locally: 313 test files and 3018 tests in kaipu-record, plus lint, format, types and the `@kaipu/*` builds. New tests cover:

- the store (`ready-copies.test.ts`);
- the runner's hide, destination and finished-copy note;
- the cards, including hide-vs-cancel through `ExportStatusCards`;
- the sidebar badge lifecycle;
- the Library chip and outline;
- the Rail badge.

Nothing has run in Electron.

## How to test it yourself

1. `bun run rebuild:native` if pending, then `bun run dev`.
2. Library → a recording → **Prepare** → **YouTube** → Prepare. The top-right card says "Preparing your YouTube copy…" with the YouTube tile, a striped bar, and "N% · about … left · you can keep working".
3. Click **✕** on it: the card goes away and the export keeps going (quitting still asks). When it ends, "Your YouTube copy is ready" appears with the fox and "2560 × 1440 · … MB · in your Library".
4. Click **✕** on the ready card: **LIBRARY** in the rail shows a pink **1**.
5. Open the Library: the badge clears, "✓ 1 copy ready" appears next to the title, and the copy's card has a pink outline. Open that copy: on returning, the chip and outline are gone.
6. Prepare another copy and click **Cancel** under the bar: it stops, and nothing new appears in the Library.
7. On a ready card, drag **Drag to upload** into Finder or a browser upload field: the real file drops, named after the item. **Show in Finder** reveals it.
8. Export from the editor: the cards say "Preparing your export…" and "Your export is ready".
9. Switch the app to Spanish and check the cards, badge and chip read naturally.
